questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the study of the structure of the earth?
explanation: Geology is correct - G-E-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek geo meaning earth and logos meaning study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning relating to the mind?
explanation: Psychological is correct - P-S-Y-C-H-O-L-O-G-I-C-A-L. The P is silent and the CH makes a K sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a sudden widespread disaster?
explanation: Catastrophe is correct - C-A-T-A-S-T-R-O-P-H-E. The PH makes an F sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning happening at the same time?
explanation: Simultaneous is correct - S-I-M-U-L-T-A-N-E-O-U-S. Meaning occurring or done at the same time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the ability to speak two languages?
explanation: Bilingualism is correct - B-I-L-I-N-G-U-A-L-I-S-M. From Latin bi meaning two and lingua meaning language.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a person who competes in a sport?
explanation: Athlete is correct - A-T-H-L-E-T-E. A common error is adding an extra E to make athelete.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the art of beautiful handwriting?
explanation: Calligraphy is correct - C-A-L-L-I-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Greek kallos meaning beauty and graphein meaning to write.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning extreme unwillingness to spend money?
explanation: Miserliness is correct - M-I-S-E-R-L-I-N-E-S-S. Double S at the end. A miser is extremely unwilling to spend money.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a formal written request?
explanation: Petition is correct - P-E-T-I-T-I-O-N. A petition is a formal document requesting something from an authority.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the state of being responsible?
explanation: Accountability is correct - A-C-C-O-U-N-T-A-B-I-L-I-T-Y. Meaning the fact of being responsible for something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning easily influenced by others?
explanation: Susceptible is correct - S-U-S-C-E-P-T-I-B-L-E. Meaning likely to be influenced by or subject to something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning firm and not changing?
explanation: Persistent is correct - P-E-R-S-I-S-T-E-N-T. A common error is using ANT instead of ENT.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning able to be seen through?
explanation: Transparent is correct - T-R-A-N-S-P-A-R-E-N-T. From Latin trans meaning through and parere meaning to appear.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning causing a lot of discussion or argument?
explanation: Controversial is correct - C-O-N-T-R-O-V-E-R-S-I-A-L. A frequently misspelled word.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a person who acts for another?
explanation: Representative is correct - R-E-P-R-E-S-E-N-T-A-T-I-V-E. The vowel pattern in the middle is often misspelled.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the state of being independent?
explanation: Autonomy is correct - A-U-T-O-N-O-M-Y. From Greek autos meaning self and nomos meaning law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning something that is very important?
explanation: Indispensable is correct - I-N-D-I-S-P-E-N-S-A-B-L-E. Note the ABLE not IBLE ending.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the quality of being the only one?
explanation: Uniqueness is correct - U-N-I-Q-U-E-N-E-S-S. From Latin unicus meaning only one. Note the QUE retained before NESS.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a formal promise?
explanation: Commitment is correct - C-O-M-M-I-T-M-E-N-T. Note only one T before MENT despite the double T in commit.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the ability to recover quickly?
explanation: Resilience is correct - R-E-S-I-L-I-E-N-C-E. From Latin resilire meaning to spring back.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the process of voting?
explanation: Referendum is correct - R-E-F-E-R-E-N-D-U-M. From Latin referendus meaning what must be referred.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a long period of dry weather?
explanation: Drought is correct - D-R-O-U-G-H-T. A silent GH makes this word frequently misspelled.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a very large and powerful person?
explanation: Colossus is correct - C-O-L-O-S-S-U-S. Double S in the middle. Means something or someone of enormous size.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning open to more than one interpretation?
explanation: Ambiguous is correct - A-M-B-I-G-U-O-U-S. From Latin ambigere meaning to go about. Note the UO combination.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning very large in size or degree?
explanation: Enormous is correct - E-N-O-R-M-O-U-S. From Latin enormis meaning out of the normal.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning relating to the sky and stars?
explanation: Celestial is correct - C-E-L-E-S-T-I-A-L. From Latin caelestis meaning heavenly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning given or caused by nature?
explanation: Innate is correct - I-N-N-A-T-E. From Latin innatus meaning born into. Double N is required.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning not easily moved or disturbed?
explanation: Imperturbable is correct - I-M-P-E-R-T-U-R-B-A-B-L-E. Note ABLE not IBLE. Meaning calm and not easily upset.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning extreme and unreasonable?
explanation: Extravagant is correct - E-X-T-R-A-V-A-G-A-N-T. From Latin extra meaning outside and vagari meaning to wander.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning clear and easy to understand?
explanation: Perspicuous is correct - P-E-R-S-P-I-C-U-O-U-S. From Latin perspicuus meaning transparent. Means clearly expressed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning unwilling to act or make decisions?
explanation: Indecisive is correct - I-N-D-E-C-I-S-I-V-E. From Latin indecisus meaning not decided.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the quality of lasting forever?
explanation: Permanence is correct - P-E-R-M-A-N-E-N-C-E. Note ENCE not ANCE. Meaning the state of lasting forever.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning showing good judgment?
explanation: Judicious is correct - J-U-D-I-C-I-O-U-S. From Latin judex meaning judge. Means having or showing good judgment.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning able to use resources without waste?
explanation: Efficient is correct - E-F-F-I-C-I-E-N-T. From Latin efficiens meaning producing. Note double F and IENT ending.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning the state of being extremely poor?
explanation: Destitution is correct - D-E-S-T-I-T-U-T-I-O-N. From Latin destituere meaning to abandon. Means extreme poverty.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning deeply felt and sincere?
explanation: Heartfelt is correct - H-E-A-R-T-F-E-L-T. Compound of heart and felt meaning deeply sincere.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning to have an excessive interest in oneself?
explanation: Narcissism is correct - N-A-R-C-I-S-S-I-S-M. Double S appears twice. From Narcissus of Greek mythology.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning easily changed or adapting quickly?
explanation: Versatile is correct - V-E-R-S-A-T-I-L-E. From Latin versatilis meaning turning. Means able to adapt to many functions.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a strong and firm decision?
explanation: Determination is correct - D-E-T-E-R-M-I-N-A-T-I-O-N. From Latin determinare meaning to set limits.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning something done against the law?
explanation: Infringement is correct - I-N-F-R-I-N-G-E-M-E-N-T. Means a violation of a right or law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning relating to the whole world?
explanation: International is correct - I-N-T-E-R-N-A-T-I-O-N-A-L. From Latin inter meaning between and natio meaning nation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning not able to be corrected?
explanation: Irreversible is correct - I-R-R-E-V-E-R-S-I-B-L-E. Double R after prefix IR. Note IBLE not ABLE ending.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning involving many steps or parts?
explanation: Complicated is correct - C-O-M-P-L-I-C-A-T-E-D. From Latin complicare meaning to fold together.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning full of energy and enthusiasm?
explanation: Enthusiastic is correct - E-N-T-H-U-S-I-A-S-T-I-C. From Greek enthousiasmos meaning divine inspiration.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning having a pleasing appearance?
explanation: Aesthetic is correct - A-E-S-T-H-E-T-I-C. From Greek aisthetikos meaning perceptive. Relating to beauty or pleasing appearance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning not acting fairly or honestly?
explanation: Dishonest is correct - D-I-S-H-O-N-E-S-T. Prefix DIS added to honest. The H is not doubled.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning relating to a system of government?
explanation: Constitutional is correct - C-O-N-S-T-I-T-U-T-I-O-N-A-L. From Latin constitutio meaning arrangement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning causing a feeling of wonder?
explanation: Magnificent is correct - M-A-G-N-I-F-I-C-E-N-T. From Latin magnificus meaning splendid. Note CENT ending not CANT.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning in addition or also?
explanation: Furthermore is correct - F-U-R-T-H-E-R-M-O-R-E. A compound of further and more meaning in addition to what has been said.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a large formal meal?
explanation: Banquet is correct - B-A-N-Q-U-E-T. From Italian banchetto meaning little bench. A banquet is an elaborate formal meal.
